consequence.statement: Existing ExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 after the upgrade; the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, re-write every ExternalSecret object so they are stored at v1, then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions of the externalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD, and only then upgrade to the later release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the externalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD changed from v1beta1 to v1 in external-secrets 0.16.0 (v1beta1 storage: true → false), so existing ExternalSecret objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update must be completed before a later release removes v1beta1.
